results.content: Despite the rebound in monthly measures, underlying inflation trends continue to move in the right direction. At 3.4%, headline CPI has put further distance from its four-year high reached in May, while the annual change on core inflation fell back to its pre-Iran conflict rate of growth. Near-term trends on core also improved, with the three-and-six-month annualized rates slipping to 1.6% (from 2.3%) and 2.4% (from 2.6%), respectively.
